what_it_is: The WARMATE family from Poland's WB Group is a man-portable electric loitering-munition line with interchangeable day/night payloads and autonomous attack profiles, marketed in WARMATE/WARMATE 2/5 configurations for tactical units.
india_angle: WB Group's Indian presence runs through WB Electronics India collaborations (the atlas also lists WB Electronics as a rich company dossier); Indian trials of Polish loitering munitions have been reported in defence media, though no confirmed Indian order is public at dossier time.
